question: What expiatory act restores purity to those who have transgressed?
premises: A specific expiatory observance is prescribed.
Performing it three times leads to purification.
inference: By performing three Prājāpatya observances, those two will become purified.
uncertainties: The identity of the two subjects is implied from the preceding verses.
plain_english: Having performed three Prājāpatya observances, those two will become purified.
